value.rationale: The family has a canonical reciprocal involution with elliptic quotient and a complementary genus-two quotient, so its ordinary and superspecial behavior is geometrically motivated. The complete marked parameter classification of all possible Cartier ranks exhibits two additional nonzero superspecial fibers and a sharp first occurrence among primes ≥5; it is not a mere isolated example or arbitrary table slice. The work distinguishes intermediate p-rank-1/2 degeneration loci beyond superspecial enumeration.
